title: How Dutch van der Linde built his gang in Red Dead 2
subject: dutch
description:
Would you have followed Dutch in 1878? 👇

How Dutch van der Linde, Hosea Matthews and two orphans became the Van der Linde gang. Spoilers for Red Dead Redemption 2.

Fan-made content. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Rockstar Games or Take-Two Interactive. Game images © their respective owners.

scenes.text: Dutch van der Linde met his best friend trying to rob him.
Hosea Matthews, an older con artist, was trying to rob Dutch too. In 1878, they became partners instead.
Dutch had a whole philosophy. Banks and governments were the real thieves, and his gang would live free of them.
That same year they took in a fourteen-year-old orphan named Arthur Morgan.
Later, Dutch saved a twelve-year-old John Marston from being hanged.
He called all of them family, and by 1899 that family was more than twenty people.
Every one of them believed Dutch always had a plan.
